features.featureTitle: Fix the comment action dropdown menu (containing Edit and Delete options) in CommentSection.tsx so it is always fully visible regardless of where the comment appears on the screen. The menu is currently being clipped or cut off due to container overflow constraints or incorrect positioning. Use a portal-based rendering approach or switch to a fixed/absolute positioning strategy that accounts for viewport boundaries (e.g., flip the dropdown upward when near the bottom of the screen, and ensure no ancestor container with overflow:hidden clips it).
